releaseNotes: Notes Pro 0.12.1 removes the persistent Textnotiz placeholder from the writing surface
Added an explicit Text mode that gives the textarea focus and opens the virtual keyboard on supported devices
Added Pen options for style, thickness and E-Ink-friendly colors plus marker width and opacity controls
Notes layout spacing and visual hierarchy were refined for cleaner separation between Notes Pro, note list and active note
The global UI/Shell version badge is now shown only on the Home screen
Existing multi-page notes, handwriting, marker, eraser, project linking and LuMa AI context remain available
No new APK is required; Shell 1.1.0 remains sufficient
